name: UI demo widgets
purpose: Generic, unbranded interface pieces for how-it-works demos: a field that types, a button press, a toggle, a cursor that moves on a hand-like arc and clicks, a notification.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.ui.input(parent, d).type(tl, at, {cps}); .button(parent, d).press(tl, at); .toggle(parent, d).flip(tl, at, on); .cursor(layer).enter/moveTo(tl, target, at)/click; .notify(parent, d).enter/exit

layout_notes: Sizes in u; scale the panel that holds them for a close demo shot; the cursor needs a full-frame layer.

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html (63 checks incl. seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; golden scene tests/reference-derived/explain-slider-ui/index.html frame review 0 errors 0 warnings and contact sheet inspected. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
